item.title: By: Lynn cornish
item.dc:creator: Lynn cornish
item.description: What to do? There is nothing to do. Electricity can't change our eternal consciousness. We are just fine as we are. We will pass and others will take our place, or not, and hopefully they will be wiser than we were, or not. And so on...
